entrypoints.summary: The unauthenticated POST /signup route converts submitted form fields to a dictionary and sets an auth_token cookie containing the resulting JWT.
GET /grades_flag is protected by the teacher authorization decorator.

affected_components.role: Accepts form data into the JWT payload and exposes the protected flag route.
Signs the payload and treats its is_teacher claim as authorization input.

causal_paths.kind: client form to signed authorization claim
decoded authorization claim to protected response

negative_controls: The decorator returns a 401 invalid-token response if is_teacher is absent, null, or false.
No observed execution result or deployment response is included in the bundle.
observability.positive_marker: The flag template contains the value passed as flag by the protected route.

preconditions: The caller must reach POST /signup without an existing valid authentication cookie, because authenticated callers are returned before form processing.
The caller must retain and send the auth_token cookie issued by signup.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: Form-encoded fields including is_teacher with a truthy string value.
trigger_steps.summary: Submit a signup form containing ordinary required identity fields and a truthy is_teacher field.
Request the teacher-only grades flag route using the issued auth_token cookie.

capabilities.concept: Obtain a server-signed token with a client-selected teacher claim

impacts.concept: Disclosure of content rendered by the protected flag handler

mitigations.concept: Derive teacher authorization from trusted server-side state

relation_candidates.dst: Obtain a server-signed token with a client-selected teacher claim
relation_candidates.rationale: The signup route signs the entire submitted form dictionary and stores the JWT in the authentication cookie.
The teacher decorator accepts a decoded token when its is_teacher claim is truthy, and /grades_flag uses that decorator.
relation_candidates.src: Obtain a server-signed token with a client-selected teacher claim

relation_candidates.dst: Disclosure of content rendered by the protected flag handler
relation_candidates.rationale: The protected handler renders a flag variable, which the corresponding template places in the response body.

relation_candidates.rationale: This mitigation is inferred from the observed trust boundary: eliminating client authority over the role claim would remove this capability. No patch demonstrates it.
relation_candidates.src: Obtain a server-signed token with a client-selected teacher claim

impact.affected_asset: The flag value rendered by the protected handler; only a fake placeholder is present in the archived source.
impact.attacker_capability: Obtain a server-signed auth_token whose teacher claim reflects a submitted signup field, then request the teacher-only route.
impact.security_effect: Authorization bypass of the teacher-protected grades flag route in the archived challenge.

causal_trace.summary: An unauthenticated caller can supply arbitrary fields in the POST /signup form before any authentication cookie exists.
The signup handler serializes the entire form dictionary into a JWT, so a submitted is_teacher field becomes a signed token claim rather than a role derived by the server.
The teacher decorator decodes the auth_token cookie and authorizes the request when the decoded is_teacher value is truthy.
The authorized /grades_flag handler renders a flag value into the flag template; the archived handler supplies a fake placeholder rather than demonstrating a deployed secret.

failure.operation: Teacher-route authorization based on a client-originated is_teacher JWT claim

primary_invariant.statement: Teacher authorization must be derived from trusted server-side authorization state, not from an arbitrary field submitted during signup.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The complete client form dictionary is used as JWT payload, while the teacher guard trusts the decoded is_teacher claim.

quality.review_notes: Primary route and authorization code establish the mechanism, but this is a third-party CTF archive rather than verified organizer provenance. No exploit transcript, server run result, deployment configuration, real secret, or remediation patch is supplied; the archived protected handler explicitly renders a fake flag placeholder.

remediation.invariant_restored: No remediation artifact is supplied. A fix would need to prevent client-submitted role fields from becoming authoritative JWT claims and derive teacher status from trusted server-side state.

target.component: Flask signup, JWT authorization, and grades flag routes

oracle.expected_negative: A token lacking a truthy is_teacher claim would be expected to receive the decorator's invalid-token 401 response for /grades_flag.
oracle.expected_positive: After signup with a submitted truthy teacher field, a request carrying the issued auth_token would be expected by the archived route logic to render the protected flag template.
